title: 310TH PSYOP COMPANY AIRBORNE JUMP
description: A group of U.S. Army Paratroopers, assigned to 310th PSYOP Company, 412th Civil Affairs Battalion (Airborne), 421st Quartermaster Company, and the 982nd Combat Camera Company (Airborne) conduct an Airborne Jump off the ramp of a Air Force C-130 aircraft, assigned to the 94th Air Wing onto Tyler Drop Zone, Dobbins Air Force Base, Marietta, GA., July 10, 2020. These Paratroopers are jumping to stay current on their jump status, and stay proficient as U.S. Army Paratroopers. (U.S. Army Reserve video by Staff Sgt. Austin Berner)
